readings: For each event type (`event.type`), matching budget lines to their events through `budget.link_to_event`, what is the average spent-to-budgeted ratio (`spent` / `amount`) across its budget lines, ignoring missing values? Also show how far each type's average is from the mean of the per-type averages.
queries:
WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_ratio,
       ABS(avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean
FROM type_averages
